answer: A signal enters forge only after proving local custody of every reef already anchored there plus one new reef; custody proofs bind to the admitting key, and forge voids proofs served from shared storage. The kth signal adds k reef of simultaneous residency, so a thousand fakes must hold 500,500 reef at once. The bill is reef of live storage per signal, attached to each admission proof. It breaks if custody can be delegated to a common host.
